description: This PHP test class file is designed to verify the functionality of the PsrHttpFactoryHelper class within the OAuth service of the OrangeHRM system. It includes unit tests for creating PSR-7 requests and responses from internal request and response objects, handling different content types, and converting PSR-7 objects back into the system's internal request/response objects. The file contains test methods that check the correctness of request URI, method, headers, body, response status code, headers, and content transfer between the internal representations and PSR-7 implementations. Overall, it ensures that the PsrHttpFactoryHelper correctly bridges between the system's internal HTTP abstractions and PSR-7 standard objects.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelperTest
classes.description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the PsrHttpFactoryHelper, verifying the correct transformation between internal HTTP request/response objects and PSR-7 compliant objects, as well as testing handling of content, headers, status codes, and request attributes.

methods.name: testCreatePsr7Request
methods.description: Tests creation of PSR-7 requests from internal Request objects, verifying URI, method, headers, and body.

methods.name: testCreatePsr7Response
methods.description: Tests creation of PSR-7 responses from internal Response objects, including handling of normal content and file responses.

methods.name: testCreateRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Tests the creation of internal Request objects from PSR-7 requests, ensuring method, URI, query parameters, and attributes are correctly mapped.

methods.name: testCreateResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Verifies conversion of PSR-7 responses back into internal Response objects with correct status code and headers.
